body.text: It is Election Day: Massachusetts voters decide whether to keep the 2024 gun law, with firearms-related questions also on ballots in AR, MO, ID and one NM county.

Nothing changes for gun owners until results are called and states certify them. ATF's chief counsel is on administrative leave since 11/2 and employed through January, per CBS citing a source; no successor named.

facts.title: 2. ATF chief counsel resigns; rules question

body.text:
• Election Day: MA Q9, AR Issue 2, MO Amend. 8, ID advisory, Lea Co. NM tax
• ATF chief counsel on leave since 11/2; successor unnamed
• MA registration deadline was 10/28 per Boston.com; 'register today' claim unsupported
• Glendale permit-cost deadline tomorrow; SCOTUS conf. Fri 11/6
